description: Buy a font licence. Call without payment to get x402 payment requirements (USDC), then again with the signed payment. Returns the signed licence and a download link per style; web licences also list WOFF2, WOFF and the original file under downloads[].formats. Spends money: confirm price and licensee with the user first.

bundle_id.description: A family bundle from get_family, e.g. <family_id>.family

font_id.description: One style. Or use font_ids or bundle_id.

font_ids.description: Several styles of the same family, priced per style

licensee.description: The person or organisation the licence is for. Never the agent itself.

email.description: Where the licence is sent; the licensee's address, not the agent's

name.description: Legal name of the person or organisation

options.description: Licence dimensions, e.g. {"visitors": 100000, "domains": 2} or {"cores": 8, "years": 2}. get_family lists them per use.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload (X-PAYMENT). Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.

tier.description: Shorthand for the first dimension of the use (desktop: computers, web: visitors/month, app: apps, ebook: titles, server: cores)

use.description: Licence type. A foundry may define its own; get_family lists them

name: buy_license
